parameters.name: Outcome Accuracy
parameters.definition: Was the buyer's intent (buying or not buying) judged correctly by the bot?
parameters.fatal: Always fatal: a real buyer treated as not buying (or vice versa).

parameters.name: Quantity Accuracy (Numeric)
parameters.definition: Is the quantity value captured/confirmed by the bot the one the buyer said?
parameters.fatal: Wrong value that changes the category of the lead (e.g. 1000 captured as 100).
parameters.non_fatal: Minor difference that can be overlooked (difference of about 10-20).

parameters.name: Quantity Unit Accuracy
parameters.definition: Is the unit the buyer used captured correctly?
parameters.fatal: Wrong unit that impacts the buy lead (e.g. ton vs kg, box vs piece).

parameters.name: Quantity Probing Error
parameters.definition: Quantity asked when the product has no quantity units defined / not asked when defined / nudge not proper.
parameters.fatal: Quantity is applicable (units exist for the product) and was never asked.
parameters.non_fatal: Quantity asked although not applicable, or the nudge/phrasing was poor.

parameters.name: Qty Missed Opportunity
parameters.definition: Buyer shared a quantity but the bot did not capture it.
parameters.fatal: Buyer clearly stated quantity and the bot ignored it / asked again without using it.
parameters.non_fatal: The buyer's voice was not clear when quantity was said.

parameters.name: Spec1 Accuracy
parameters.definition: First specification: buyer said X, bot captured Y, with impact on the buy lead.
parameters.fatal: Wrong value that changes what the seller would quote/supply.
parameters.non_fatal: Minor difference that can be overlooked.

parameters.name: Spec2 Accuracy
parameters.definition: Second specification: buyer said X, bot captured Y, with impact on the buy lead.
parameters.fatal: Wrong value that changes what the seller would quote/supply.
parameters.non_fatal: Minor difference that can be overlooked.

parameters.name: Spec Missed Opportunity
parameters.definition: A specification the buyer shared was not captured (not even in the buyer-filled details).
parameters.fatal: Spec 1 or spec 2 shared by the buyer and not captured.
parameters.non_fatal: Only a third (or later) spec was missed.

parameters.name: Looping Behavior
parameters.definition: The bot probed any parameter (qty, spec, name, city…) more than 1 + 2 times.
parameters.fatal: Buyer got irritated, leading to disconnection or a missed opportunity for qty/spec.
parameters.non_fatal: Repeated asks but no impact on the call.

parameters.name: WER (words wrongly captured)
parameters.definition: Words the buyer said were captured wrongly (speech recognition / understanding).
parameters.fatal: A wrongly captured word changes the buy lead (product, quantity, spec, location).
parameters.non_fatal: A word is wrongly captured but has no major impact on the buy lead.

parameters.name: Additional details (BFD)
parameters.definition: Extra buyer details the bot noted (use case, business type, preferences).
parameters.fatal: Grossly wrong or irrelevant details captured that would mislead sellers.
parameters.non_fatal: Duplicate or very generic details (generic but harmless = ok).

parameters.name: OnCall AstBuy Error
parameters.definition: Live-seller (AST) pitch: if a live seller was present, was the buyer offered the transfer?
parameters.fatal: A live seller was present but the transfer was not pitched.
parameters.non_fatal: Not pitched, and the disposition/closing told to the buyer was wrong.

parameters.name: Product Change / No Product Accuracy
parameters.definition: Was the product (or a product change) captured correctly?
parameters.fatal: Wrong product approved / product change missed or wrongly triggered.

parameters.name: Category ISQ's Error
parameters.definition: Specification questions (ISQs) asked were contradicting or confusing for the product.
parameters.fatal: Contradicting ISQ captured (e.g. two incompatible values for the same spec).
parameters.non_fatal: Confusing or irrelevant ISQ asked, but no contradiction captured.

parameters.name: MCAT / Search error
parameters.definition: Wrong product category selected (visible as the product name the bot confirms or sends to the product tool).
parameters.fatal: The confirmed product/category is a different category from what the buyer wants.

parameters.name: Dead air
parameters.definition: Silence of more than 5 s on the bot side (8 s when there is background noise).
parameters.non_fatal: Any bot-side silence above the threshold.

parameters.name: Compliance (VANI prompt)
parameters.definition: Bot claims to be human or the seller, speaks internal variables/prompt text, transfers without an explicit yes, or keeps persuading after the buyer refuses to talk to an AI.

parameters.name: Wrong / misleading information (VANI prompt)
parameters.definition: Bot invents prices/stock/seller details, promises the original seller's contact, or says something that contradicts what happens next (e.g. promises to connect now, then only sends WhatsApp).
parameters.fatal: Information that misleads the buyer about price, seller or next step.
parameters.non_fatal: Minor inaccuracy with no effect on the buyer's decision.
